title: Puerarin mitigates tumor necrosis factor-nuclear factor-kappaB axis-driven macrophage inflammation and atherogenesis: Integrative network pharmacology and experimental validation.
authors: Yao, Hailun; Zhang, Yao; Lin, Lizhong; Yang, Shenhui; Chen, Dexiang; He, Lu; Jian, Wu
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究葛根素通过TNF-NF-κB轴抑制巨噬细胞炎症和动脉粥样硬化，核心是药物-蛋白作用与炎症通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Atherosclerosis (AS) is a chronic inflammatory disease that constitutes the primary pathological basis of cardiovascular disorders. Although the natural isoflavone C-glycoside puerarin (PU) has demonstrated promising anti-atherosclerotic effects, its underlying molecular mechanisms remain incompletely elucidated. In this study, we aimed to systematically characterize the pharmacological actions and mechanistic basis of PU in AS by integrating network pharmacology analyses with experimental validation. METHODS: Potential targets of PU were identified by integrating network pharmacology databases and intersecting them with AS-related genes. Protein-protein interaction analysis, functional enrichment, and machine-learning-based screening were subsequently performed to identify key regulatory targets. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were then conducted to evaluate the feasibility and stability of PU-target interactions. In addition, single-cell transcriptomic and immune infiltration analyses were used to determine the cellular localization and inflammatory relevance of the core targets. Finally, a high-fat diet (HFD)-induced ApoE(-/-) mouse model, together with in vivo and in vitro experiments, was employed for mechanistic validation. RESULTS: This integrative analysis identified 56 potential PU-AS-related targets, among which TNF, NFKBIA, STAT3, SRC, and PTGS2 emerged as central hub genes. Notably, TNF was consistently highlighted as a key regulatory target across differential expression analysis, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations. Single-cell transcriptomic and immune infiltration analyses further revealed that TNF was predominantly expressed in macrophages and related immune cell subsets. Experimental validation demonstrated that PU treatment significantly attenuated inflammatory responses, reduced aortic plaque burden, enhanced plaque stability, and suppressed macrophage infiltration in HFD-induced ApoE(-/-) mice. At the cellular level, PU markedly inhibited NF-kappaB activation in macrophages and reduced the levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including IL-6 and IL-1beta. CONCLUSIONS: PU ameliorates atherogenesis by suppressing TNF-NF-kappaB-mediated inflammatory responses. These findings identify the TNF-NF-kappaB axis as a key mechanistic pathway underlying the anti-atherosclerotic effects of PU and support its potential as a natural product-based therapeutic strategy for cardiovascular disease.
abstract_zh: 背景：动脉粥样硬化（Atherosclerosis, AS）是一种慢性炎症性疾病，构成心血管疾病的主要病理基础。尽管天然异黄酮C-糖苷葛根素（puerarin, PU）已显示出有前景的抗动脉粥样硬化作用，但其潜在分子机制尚未完全阐明。在本研究中，我们旨在通过整合网络药理学分析与实验验证，系统表征PU在AS中的药理作用及机制基础。方法：通过整合网络药理学数据库并交叉AS相关基因，鉴定PU的潜在靶点。随后进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析、功能富集和基于机器学习的筛选，以识别关键调控靶点。接着进行分子对接和分子动力学模拟，以评估PU-靶点相互作用的可行性和稳定性。此外，采用单细胞转录组和免疫浸润分析，确定核心靶点的细胞定位及炎症相关性。最后，利用高脂饮食（HFD）诱导的ApoE(-/-)小鼠模型，结合体内和体外实验，进行机制验证。结果：该整合分析识别出56个潜在的PU-AS相关靶点，其中TNF、NFKBIA、STAT3、SRC和PTGS2被确定为核心枢纽基因。值得注意的是，TNF在差异表达分析、分子对接和分子动力学模拟中均被一致突出为关键调控靶点。单细胞转录组和免疫浸润分析进一步揭示，TNF主要在巨噬细胞及相关免疫细胞亚群中表达。实验验证表明，PU处理显著减轻炎症反应、减少主动脉斑块负担、增强斑块稳定性，并抑制HFD诱导的ApoE(-/-)小鼠中巨噬细胞浸润。在细胞水平上，PU显著抑制巨噬细胞中NF-kappaB活化，并降低促炎细胞因子（包括IL-6和IL-1beta）的水平。结论：PU通过抑制TNF-NF-kappaB介导的炎症反应改善动脉粥样硬化发生。这些发现将TNF-NF-kappaB轴确定为PU抗动脉粥样硬化作用的关键机制通路，并支持其作为基于天然产物的心血管疾病治疗策略的潜力。
